about: What an affected run (tools/test.sh affected) runs again for each file changed since the last
commit green in full (both levels on a clean tree). The first rule with a pattern that matches
a path decides. A path that no rule matches needs both levels in full: the plugins, speakerd,
the controller, ampd.py, the virtual pair's harness and stand-ins, the build and test
.claude/settings.json), this file, CI and the JUCE submodule. "tests" lists test modules of
tests/vpair; "self" is the changed test module itself. Every module that imports one that
runs runs too. Patterns are fnmatch patterns on the path from the repository's root, where *
also matches /. tools/status.py reads this file from the base commit, never from the commit
under test, so a change to it counts only from the next commit green in full.
